description: A square wave oscillator with two windows cut into the cycle, each window replaced by a ramp, a hold or a triangle, followed by a low-pass filter and a tanh drive

params.text: Sets the base pitch, four octaves below C4 at the counter-clockwise end and four octaves above it at the clockwise end, with C4 at 261.63Hz in the middle
Sets where in the cycle the first window opens, 0 to 100% of the way through
Sets how much of the cycle the first window covers, 0 to 100%; at 0 that window is switched off
Sets where in the cycle the second window opens, 0 to 100% of the way through
Sets how much of the cycle the second window covers, 0 to 100%; at 0 that window is switched off
Sweeps a one-pole low-pass down the output from about 4186Hz to 20Hz; at the counter-clockwise stop the filter is taken out of the path altogether
Drives the wave into a tanh, no drive at the counter-clockwise stop and ten times fully clockwise, with the result divided back down so the peaks stay where they were
Sets the shape inside a window: a rising ramp fully counter-clockwise, a flat hold at the bottom of the swing in the middle, and a triangle fully clockwise
Sets the output level, silent at the counter-clockwise end and ±5V peaks fully clockwise
Crossfades between a plain 50% square wave at the counter-clockwise end and the windowed wave at the clockwise end

inputs.text: Adds to the base pitch at one volt per octave
A rise above 2V restarts the cycle from its beginning and fires the trigger output
Modulates the pitch, four volts raising it by an octave
Moves where the first window opens, 10V covering the whole cycle, and the total with the knob is held between 0 and 100%
Moves how much of the cycle the first window covers, 10V covering the whole cycle, and the total with the knob is held between 0 and 100%
Moves where the second window opens, 10V covering the whole cycle, and the total with the knob is held between 0 and 100%
Moves how much of the cycle the second window covers, 10V covering the whole cycle, and the total with the knob is held between 0 and 100%
Moves the low-pass sweep, 10V covering the whole span, and the total with the knob is held inside it
Moves the tanh drive, 10V covering the whole span, and the total with the knob is held inside it
Moves the window shape for both windows at once, 5V carrying it from the middle to one end, and the total with the knob is held inside the span
Moves the output level, 10V covering the whole range, and the total with the knob is held between silence and full
Moves the crossfade between the plain square and the windowed wave, 10V covering the whole span, and the total with the knob is held inside it

outputs.text: A 10V pulse 1ms long each time the cycle wraps round, and each time a rise at the sync input restarts it
10V for as long as the cycle is inside the first window, and 0V through the rest of the cycle
10V for as long as the cycle is inside the second window, and 0V through the rest of the cycle
The shaped wave as audio, reaching ±5V with the level knob fully clockwise

notes: the four window knobs and the shape knob change nothing while gulf / dry is fully counter-clockwise, where the output is a plain square wave
where the two windows overlap, the first one is used for the whole of the shared stretch and the second gate stays at 0V
the four window knobs come up at the proportions of a 947-day timeline the maker built the module around, which is why the two windows start narrow and far apart
there are three lamps above the output jacks: a yellow one lit while the first window is open, a red one for the second, and a green one following the output level
